# 1. Charter Banking House (特许附庸设立银庄)
oe_wp35_subj_charter_banking_house = {
	type = subject
	category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
	use_enroute = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		gold >= 200
		any_subject = { country_type = location }
	}
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			current_year >= 1337
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
			any_subject = { country_type = location }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			gold >= 120
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			country_type = location
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_subj_bank_cd }
			subject_loyalty >= 45
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -120
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_overlord_bank_dividend years = 15 mode = replace }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_gold = 60
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_chartered_bank years = 15 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_subject_patronage }
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_wp35_subj_bank_cd years = 15 }
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -30
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = { gold >= 400 }
				scope:recipient ?= { num_locations >= 5 }
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

# 2. Establish Sister Republic (扶立姊妹共和国)
oe_wp35_subj_establish_sister_republic = {
	type = subject
	category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
	use_enroute = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		government_type = government_type:republic
		any_subject = { country_type = location NOT = { government_type = government_type:republic } }
	}
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			current_year >= 1337
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
			government_type = government_type:republic
			any_subject = { country_type = location }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			prestige >= 10
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			country_type = location
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { government_type = government_type:republic }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_subj_sister_rep_cd }
			subject_loyalty >= 50
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_sister_republic_pact years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				change_government_type = government_type:republic
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_sister_republic_pact years = 20 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_subject_patronage }
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_wp35_subj_sister_rep_cd years = 20 }
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -25
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = { prestige >= 25 }
				scope:recipient ?= { subject_loyalty >= 60 }
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}
}

				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_subject_patronage }
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_wp35_subj_maritime_lease_cd years = 15 }
			}

	ai_will_do = {

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country

			scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			country_type = location
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_subj_integrity_cd }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -5

			scope:recipient = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_subj_protected value = 1 years = 20 }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_guaranteed_integrity years = 20 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_integrity_guarantee }

			}
			add = 65
		}
	}
}

# 5. Subject Territorial Reassignment (敕定附庸疆界划拨)
oe_wp35_subj_territorial_reassignment = {
	type = subject
	category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
	use_enroute = no
	ai_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			current_year >= 1337
			NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
			num_locations >= 2
			any_subject = { country_type = location }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			country_type = location
			is_rebel_country = no
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_subj_reassign_cd }
			any_owned_location = {
				any_neighbor_location = {
					owner ?= scope:actor
					controller ?= scope:actor
					is_capital = no
				}
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = actor
		source_flags = only_actual_locations
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_wp35_subj_choose_border_loc"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = development }
		visible = {
			owner ?= scope:actor
			controller ?= scope:actor
			is_capital = no
			any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= scope:recipient }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
			scope:target = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = scope:recipient } }
					add_core = scope:recipient
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_wp35_bias_territorial_grant }
				add_cooldown = { type = oe_wp35_subj_reassign_cd years = 5 }
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}
